purpose: Re-run requested benchmark architectures 8 through 12 after fixing both replay architecture clamps and making out-of-range requests fail instead of silently clamping.
invariant: Production architecture 0 remained unchanged. Matrix 21 is the first valid execution of modes 9-12; Matrices 17-20 are retained only as invalidated harness evidence.
primary_gate: moving clear-to-5% <=70 ms; moving-flash reduction >=0.45; perceptual minimum reduction >=0.70; WCAG SC 2.3.1 and 2.3.2 pass
interpretation: No architecture passed. Real modes 9, 11, and 12 each improved moving-flash reduction by only about 0.004 over mode 8, far short of the 0.45 gate. Mode 10 increased perceptual attenuation but worsened moving-flash suppression and violated the 70 ms trail gate. The next diagnostic measures authority on every active-square sample and splits true transitions from stable half-cycles before another protection mechanism is added.
evidence_serialization: Repository copies are UTF-8 LF JSON serializations of the artifact JSON values.
